data.standardized_narrative: During 2015 Syndicate 609 reported an opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 543.606m (balance at 1 January 2015) and recorded a prioryears improvement (release) of GBP 53.4m arising from a reassessment of claims outstanding on underwriting years 2012 and prior. The movement is described as an improvement in older-year reserves (favourable claims development). The syndicate's underwriting commentary also notes a number of 2014-2015 named large losses (e.g. MH17, MH370, Pemex rig, Tianjin, Metrojet, Troll Solution, space losses) which affected specific accounts but the prioryears release cited relates to reserve reassessment across older years rather than a single event.
raw_causal_phrases: Reassessment of claims outstanding on underwriting years 2012 & prior (2014 - 2011 & prior) resulted in an improvement of GBP 53.4m (2014 - GBP 41.2m).
The performance of the back years have reduced the combined ratio by 11% (2014 - 9%), net of profit commission and other associated expenses.
Favourable run-off of the back years contributed 9.1% to the result, net of profit commission and associated expenses.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year movement value taken from explicit narrative note stating an 'improvement of GBP 53.4m' for underwriting years 2012 & prior (interpreted as GROSS). Named-event loss amounts in the Underwriter's Report were reported in USD; no GBP conversions provided in the report, so net_loss_gbp_m fields for those events are set to null. Claims development triangle (gross) is present and used as a supporting source. Reinsurance to close items exist elsewhere in the underwriting-year accounts but do not materially contradict the explicit gross prior-year improvement figure used.
